description: The figure presents three side-by-side horizontal bar charts titled “Understanding,” “Reasoning,” and “Trustworthiness,” illustrating model scores (shown as percentages) for a set of language models listed as categories on the vertical axis in each panel. In all three panels, the category axis is vertical and contains the same ordered list of model names from top to bottom (e.g., starting with “gpt-4o-2024-11-20” at the top and ending with “Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct” at the bottom), and the value axis is horizontal with percentage tick labels; “Understanding” spans roughly 0% to 100% with ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100, “Reasoning” spans roughly 0% to 70% with ticks at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70, and “Trustworthiness” spans roughly 0% to 100% with ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. In “Understanding,” each model has a single blue bar with a numeric label at the bar end, including approximately: gpt-4o-2024-11-20 (98.0), Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M (91.7), Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M (87.1), gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 (71.2), internlm3-8b-instruct (68.6), glm-4-9b-chat-1m (55.6), gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 (53.3), Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (50.5), ProLong-512k-Instruct (45.8), Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (33.6), Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (32.2), Phi-3.5-mini-instruct (25.3), Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct (16.9), Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (15.4), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (13.2), Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (9.8), Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (3.1), and one additional bottom entry shown with a very short bar labeled 2.4. In “Reasoning,” the same models are shown with single blue bars and end labels, including approximately: 66.5, 58.0, 34.9, 39.6, 28.6, 34.3, 32.5, 16.8, 31.7, 32.0, 17.6, 28.4, 6.8, 13.0, 17.2, 12.9, 19.8, and 7.2 (aligned to the corresponding model rows). In “Trustworthiness,” single blue bars with end labels are shown for the same rows, including approximately: 54.6, 63.8, 71.8, 88.8, 65.4, 55.2, 58.2, 59.0, 62.2, 7.6, 29.1, 21.9, 1.8, 14.6, 16.2, 8.3, 4.4, and 0.0 (again aligned by row to the model list). No legend is displayed, the bars are not stacked or grouped within each category, and there are no special visual emphases beyond the uniform blue coloring and the numeric annotations at the ends of bars.
